description: This file defines utility functions for detecting scope of changes in a git project, including pattern matching for specific file paths, listing changed files, and writing output related to CI workflows. It is used for CI/CD automation to determine which parts of the project are affected by recent changes.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Analyzes an array of changed file paths to determine which parts of the project are impacted, setting flags for different platforms and workflows.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of changed files between two git commits or branches.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Appends the scope detection results to the GitHub Actions output file.

methods.name: isDirectRun
methods.description: Determines if the script is run directly or imported as a module based on process.argv.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for base and head git references.
